name: braum-probe
description: Braum 布隆 CF 探针 — 轻量级 Cloudflare Workers 网络探针

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @braum/shared build && pnpm --filter @braum/web build:worker && pnpm agent:build
scripts.agent:build: mkdir -p dist/agent && cd apps/agent && GOCACHE=${GOCACHE:-/tmp/braum-go-cache} go build -trimpath -o ../../dist/agent/braum-agent ./cmd/braum-agent
scripts.db:migrate: pnpm exec wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config wrangler.jsonc
